events.title: Coal Duty Enters Early Access on October 27
events.summary: Hello miners, We have a date. Coal Duty enters Early Access on October 27. Five of us started this as the co-op horror game we actually wanted to play. In a few weeks you get to find out whether we managed it. (Full operational capacity has been scheduled. Attendance is mandatory and also voluntary.) You go down, you work, you try to hit quota and you come back up. events.title: Playtest is LIVE!
events.summary: Coal Duty Playtest is live on Steam!(The sun is still gone. We also don’t know why…)In this build, you can test the core gameplay loop: go down the mine, work, try to meet the quota, repeat.We opened early access because we’re tired of breaking the game alone so you can join in too. You can request Playtest access on our Steam page.Have fun!

events.title: 1,500 Wishlists in 1 Week!
events.summary: Hello everyone! We wanted to drop in and give a massive thank you to everyone who has shown interest in Coal Duty so far. To be honest, we’re absolutely floored; hitting 1,500 wishlists in our first week is a dream come true for our team. Since we’re still riding this high, we figured it was the perfect time to share some details about ourselves and who is behind the scenes! Who are we? We are a small indie crew of five friends working hard to bring this dystopian, coal-dusted nightmare to life.
